{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Torii tunnel at Fushimi Inari: go early, climb a little, let the fox statues watch over you."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done Kyoto-style, gentle and deep; the set lunch is a quiet first bite."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gion's wooden facades and side lanes; keep your eyes up for tea-house lanterns."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old soba house with warm broth and buckwheat; the vegetarian bowl is the reason to sit down."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Pontocho after dark: narrow alley, paper lanterns, the river just a breath away."}]}
